records.translation: jaunty/16 18/farmer 9 24 0 George 16 18 1 Harvey 15 18 1/skippable/move farmer 0 -4 1/move farmer 1 0 1/speak Harvey "好了，喬治。請替我深呼吸。"/pause 700/speak Harvey "嗯哼……請轉過去。"/pause 300/faceDirection George 2/faceDirection George 3/speak Harvey "喬治，我就坦白說吧。想保持健康，你就必須改變生活方式。#$b#我希望你減少攝取鈉，並試著用手臂做些適度運動。"/emote George 12/speak George "哼……我最清楚什麼對自己最好。你以為自己是誰，竟敢告訴我該怎麼過日子？"/pause 500/speak Harvey "喬治，我是你的醫生。我就是這個身分……#$b#而且我念了8年書，就是為了學習如何幫助人們保持健康。"/move farmer 0 -1 1/move farmer 5 0 0/faceDirection Harvey 2 true/faceDirection George 2/speak Harvey "哦！#$b#抱歉，但你不該待在這裡……這種檢查應該是私下進行的。"/faceDirection farmer 3/speak George "慢著！我想聽聽這位年輕人的第二意見。^慢著！我想聽聽這位年輕女士的第二意見。"/faceDirection farmer 1/speak Harvey "好吧……"/speak Harvey "$q 84 null#@，你覺得喬治應該怎麼做？#$r 84 40 event_george1 friend_George_-20#喬治應該聽從哈維醫生的建議。#$r 84 40 event_george1 friend_George_-20#喬治最清楚自己的身體。"/faceDirection Harvey 1/faceDirection George 2/emote George 28/speak George "好吧。醫生，我會照你說的做。"/pause 500/faceDirection Harvey 2/speak Harvey "$p 84#謝謝你幫忙，@。我很感激。$h|@，最好別向病人傳達互相矛盾的訊息。以後請記住這點。"/end

jaunty/10 21/farmer -100 -100 0 Gus 10 21 2 Pam -101 -101 0/skippable/pause 200/emote Gus 28/pause 500/playSound doorClose/warp farmer 14 24/pause 500/faceDirection Gus 1 true/move farmer 0 -3 3/speak Gus "哦，你好，朋友。^嗨，@。"/pause 500/faceDirection Gus 2/move farmer -3 0 2/pause 800/faceDirection farmer 3/pause 400/emote farmer 8/pause 700/speak Gus "*嘆氣*……我只是在查看上個月的收入……情況不太妙，@。$s#$b#最糟糕的是……雖然她是朋友，我很不想這麼說……但就是潘姆！她已經好幾星期沒付帳了！$s#$b#……可我開不了口。我知道她會立刻防衛起來，也不想傷她的感情。$s"/pause 600/faceDirection Gus 1/speak Gus "@，你得幫幫我！$s"/stopMusic/pause 500/playSound doorClose/warp Pam 14 24/move Pam 0 -3 3/faceDirection Gus 1 true/faceDirection farmer 1/emote Gus 16/speak Pam "嗨呀！$h#$b#格斯……我渴得要命，你應該懂我的意思。"/emote Gus 28/speak Gus "呃……好吧，潘姆。$s"/emote Gus 28/pause 700/emote Pam 8/pause 400/speak Pam "$q 207 null#@，這裡是怎麼回事？#$r 207 -50 event_credit1#你現在就得把欠帳付清！#$r 208 15 event_credit2#酒館的財務狀況不太好"/pause 400/faceDirection Pam 1/emote Pam 12/speak Pam "……$u#$b#*嘆氣*……好吧，看來我最好把欠帳付清。$s"/move Pam -2 0 0/move Pam 0 -1 3/move Pam -2 0 2/faceDirection Gus 0/faceDirection farmer 3/playSound money/pause 500/speak Gus "謝謝，潘姆！$h"/pause 500/faceDirection Gus 1/speak Gus "也謝謝你，@。$u"/pause 500/faceDirection Gus 0/speak Gus "好了，潘姆，來替你倒杯酒。$h"/friendship Gus 50/end dialogue Gus "謝謝你幫忙，@。這筆現金會給酒館很大幫助。"

pause 500/speak Sebastian "開始吧……"/globalFade/viewport -1000 -1000/playMusic Crystal Bells/cutscene boardGame/pause 1700/message "國王委託你和同伴奪回索拉里昂法杖……若能成功完成任務，你們不僅會在傳奇殿堂取得一席之地，還會得到一大筆金銀財寶。"/pause 800/message "你們穿越無情的大地，經過整整一個月的旅程，終於踏上懸崖，看見目的地聳立在遠方。"/pause 100/message "月光照耀的平原彼端，死靈法師之塔矗立在那裡……恐懼領主薩斯正把偷來的索拉里昂法杖力量用於邪惡目的。"/pause 500/pause 700/updateMinigame 1/resetVariable/pause 700/question fork1 "高塔就在眼前。#從正門進入。命運眷顧勇者。#尋找後門。繼續隱藏行蹤。"/fork backEntrance/pause 500/updateMinigame 3/pause 50/playSound skeletonStep/pause 100/playMusic bigDrums/pause 500/message "一具骷髏守在前方的走廊裡，看起來很危險。"/pause 900/resetVariable/question fork1 "你要怎麼做？#與骷髏交戰。#轉身逃跑。"/fork ranAway/pause 500/resetVariable/question fork0 "骷髏向前撲來！#揮動武器。#舉起盾牌。"/fork swungWeapons/pause 600/playSound clubhit/updateMinigame -1/pause 500/message "你成功擋下攻擊。骷髏踉蹌後退，讓你有足夠時間出手，殺死這頭邪惡生物。"/pause 200/playSound swordswipe/pause 400/playSound skeletonDie/updateMinigame 5/updateMinigame -1/pause 1000/addMailReceived killedSkeleton/message "你繼續沿著走廊前進，小心翼翼地避開骷髏遺骸。"/pause 900/switchEvent sewer

none/-9999 -4/farmer 13 6 3 Abigail 3 6 2/skippable/showFrame Abigail 20/specificTemporarySprite abbyvideoscreen/viewport 9 4 true/pause 1000/playSound Cowboy_gunshot/pause 150/emote Abigail 52/pause 800/playSound Cowboy_gunshot/pause 150/playSound Cowboy_gunshot/pause 150/playSound Cowboy_gunshot/temporarySprite 2 4 27 8 50/shake Abigail 500/pause 150/playSound Cowboy_gunshot/pause 150/temporarySprite 4 4 27 8 50 true/playSound Cowboy_gunshot/pause 450/playSound Cowboy_monsterDie/pause 550/playSound Cowboy_gunshot/pause 150/playSound cowboy_dead/pause 850/emote Abigail 28/playMusic distantBanjo/showFrame Abigail 21/pause 80/showFrame Abigail 22/pause 80/move farmer -1 0 3/move farmer -3 0 3/faceDirection Abigail 1/pause 200/emote Abigail 16/pause 600/speak Abigail "@？"/move farmer -3 0 3/speak Abigail "你那樣偷偷溜進我房間，嚇死我了！"/faceDirection Abigail 0/speak Abigail "*嘆氣*……我已經玩了好幾個小時的「草原王之旅」，連第一關都過不了……$s#$b#這遊戲難得太離譜了！$a#$b#好吧，也可能只是我玩得太爛。$s"/faceDirection Abigail 1/pause 1000/emote Abigail 16/pause 300/speak Abigail "嘿，要不要一起試試這一關？有你幫忙，我想自己會表現得更好。"/faceDirection farmer 3/farmerAnimation 97/pause 1000/faceDirection Abigail 0/move farmer 0 1 3/move farmer -4 0 0/move farmer 0 -1 0/faceDirection farmer 0/pause 500/globalFade/cutscene AbigailGame/pause 500/faceDirection Abigail 3/stopMusic/faceDirection farmer 1/fork beatGame/pause 600/emote Abigail 28/pause 400/speak Abigail "呃，我放棄……永遠都過不了第一關。$s#$b#算了……謝謝你試著幫忙。"/faceDirection farmer 2/showFrame 96/emote farmer 40/pause 1000/end

pause 400/pause 100/faceDirection Alex 1/speak Alex "哦……我在和達斯迪說話。#$b#其實我們有很多共同點。$s"/faceDirection Alex 2/pause 1000/showFrame Alex 27/pause 600/playMusic desolate/emote Alex 28/speak Alex "我通常不喜歡談這些事……但我們已經當了一陣子朋友，我想自己可以信任你。$s"/pause 1000/faceDirection Alex 0/pause 500/speak Alex "你有沒有想過，我為什麼和祖父母住在一起？$s#$b#我父親不是個好人……他……嗯，他毀了我和媽媽的一切。$a#$b#有一半時間他都不在家……另一半時間，他整晚喝酒，說我一文不值，永遠不會有出息。$a#$b#我想他怨恨我年輕……因為自己浪費青春、一事無成而滿懷苦澀。$a"/faceDirection Alex 1/speak Alex "嗯……反正這只是我的看法。誰知道他心裡到底在想什麼。$a"/pause 800/speak Alex "有一天他離開了，不久後媽媽生病去世。我別無選擇，只能搬去和祖父母住。$s"/move farmer 0 1 1/pause 3000/emote Alex 40/faceDirection Alex 0/playMusic spring_day_ambient/pause 500/faceDirection farmer 2/pause 500/speak Alex "知道嗎？一直想這些事毫無意義……我不想得到任何人的同情。#$b#人得看事情光明的一面……童年雖然不美好，卻也讓我變得堅強。我非得堅強不可。"/pause 1000/speak Alex "來，我讓你看看達斯迪為了一塊烤牛排會做什麼。$h"/faceDirection Alex 1/faceDirection farmer 1/showFrame Alex 26/specificTemporarySprite joshSteak/playSound dwop/pause 500/pause 500/speak Alex "哈！看牠口水流成那樣。我想牠喜歡牛排的程度和我不相上下。$h"/playSound dogWhining/pause 3000/end

continue/-10000 -1000/farmer -100 -100 2 Elliott -100 -100 2/addConversationTopic ElliottGone1 0/addConversationTopic elliottGone 6/addWorldState elliottGone/skippable/warp Elliott 63 15/warp farmer -100 -100/faceDirection Elliott 2/showFrame Elliott 38/viewport 64 15 clamp true/pause 1000/pause 2000/playSound doorClose/warp farmer 64 15/positionOffset farmer 0 16/pause 500/faceDirection farmer 3/emote farmer 8/pause 500/showFrame Elliott 39/emote Elliott 16/pause 500/speak Elliott "@！我剛收到最令人興奮的消息！"/pause 50/jump Elliott/pause 500/speak Elliott "通知來得很突然……但我受邀為自己的書《%book》舉辦朗讀巡迴！"/emote farmer 32/showFrame Elliott 0/faceDirection Elliott 1/pause 500/emote Elliott 28/pause 400/speak Elliott "……我會離開城鎮一個星期。你一個人沒問題嗎？$s"/quickQuestion #沒問題，我會照顧好自己。#我會開心得像隻蛤蜊！#別走！(break)emote Elliott 20\speak Elliott "我會非常想你，親愛的。#$b#當然，我每天都會寫信給你！"\emote farmer 20(break)jump Elliott\pause 500\speak Elliott "哈……說得好。好了，先別太興奮……$8#$b#我保證每天都會寫信給你。我會想你的！"(break)speak Elliott "可是，親愛的……這對我而言是難得的機會。我非去不可！$s#$b#請別讓我為此感到罪惡。我每天都會寫信給你，而且一轉眼就回來了。"/pause 1000/animate Elliott true true 100 35/animate farmer true true 100 101/specificTemporarySprite heart 63 15/pause 2000/stopAnimation Elliott/showFrame Elliott 4/stopAnimation farmer/pause 500/speak Elliott "我明天一早就出發……#$b#得去打包了！$8"/end dialogue Elliott "別讓我忘了髮刷、定型噴霧、細齒梳，還有石榴潤髮乳！"

spring_day_ambient/-1000 -1000/farmer 27 13 0 Penny 26 13 1/fade unfade/makeInvisible 26 13/makeInvisible 20 4/eyes 1 -10/positionOffset farmer 0 8/viewport -100 -100 true unfreeze/pause 1000/emote farmer 24/pause 3000/showFrame Penny 21/startJittering/pause 500/stopJittering/showFrame Penny 4/pause 500/speak Penny "@……早安……$11"/pause 1000/showFrame Penny 21/startJittering/pause 500/stopJittering/showFrame Penny 4/pause 500/faceDirection farmer 3/emote Penny 32/pause 500/faceDirection farmer 2/emote farmer 16/jump farmer/pause 1000/animate Penny false true 150 4 5 6 7/positionOffset Penny 2 0/pause 100/positionOffset Penny 2 0/pause 100/positionOffset Penny 2 0/pause 100/positionOffset Penny 2 0/pause 100/positionOffset Penny 2 0/pause 100/positionOffset Penny 2 0/pause 100/positionOffset Penny 2 0/pause 100/positionOffset Penny 2 0/pause 100/positionOffset Penny 2 0/pause 100/positionOffset Penny 2 0/stopAnimation Penny/showFrame Penny 21/pause 500/speak Penny "有沒有注意到哪裡軟得不尋常？這條訂製床罩是我親手縫的。$11"/eyes -1 2000/startJittering/pause 2000/stopJittering/speak Penny "那麼，你覺得怎麼樣？$11"/quickQuestion #看起來很棒！#我不喜歡。(break)emote Penny 20\speak Penny "很高興你喜歡。家裡開始變得很舒適了，對吧？$h"\faceDirection Penny 2\faceDirection farmer 2\emote farmer 20\faceDirection farmer 3\faceDirection Penny 1\pause 1000\animate Penny false true 100 35\animate farmer true true 100 101(break)emote Penny 28\speak Penny "哦……好吧。$s#$b#我把舊家具放進箱子了……想換回來就換吧……$s"\faceDirection Penny 3/pause 3000/fade/viewport -1000 -1000/pause 500/message "潘妮在家裡一直非常努力……"/pause 500/message "這裡真的有家的感覺了！"/pause 2000/end

clubloop/7 4/farmer 7 8 0 MrQi 7 4 0/skippable/move farmer 0 -2 0/pause 3000/speak MrQi "嗯，嗯，嗯……看看是誰來到了我的祕密核桃房。"/pause 1000/faceDirection MrQi 1 true/pause 100/faceDirection MrQi 2/pause 1000/speak MrQi "我真的很佩服。#$b#即使只需要一小部分核桃就能完全進入島嶼，你仍然決定繼續挑戰自己。#$b#你進入這扇祕密門的渴望如此強烈，甚至願意付出額外努力進到裡面。#$b#孩子，正是這股衝勁讓你與眾不同。你有一股非常特別的能量。"/pause 1000/faceDirection MrQi 3 true/pause 100/faceDirection MrQi 0/pause 500/speak MrQi "話雖如此……#$b#你該不會以為挑戰到此結束吧？#$b#不……哈。哈。哈……其實挑戰才剛開始。"/faceDirection MrQi 3 true/pause 40/faceDirection MrQi 2/pause 1000/faceDirection MrQi 3/speak MrQi "左邊有塊布告板，上面列著一些非常有趣的機會。#$b#這些專為你設計的挑戰，會把你逼到極限。"/faceDirection MrQi 2/speak MrQi "不過，只要成功征服我的挑戰，就能賺取一種獨家貨幣……我稱之為「齊鑽」"/pause 400/speak MrQi "孩子，可別把它們放進嘴裡……放射性非常高。嘿。嘿。嘿……"/emote farmer 28/pause 500/faceDirection MrQi 1/speak MrQi "你可以使用右邊的機器，把這些齊鑽換成稀有而強大的獎勵。"/pause 1000/faceDirection MrQi 2/speak MrQi "聽起來很有意思，對吧？#$b#是啊……我有預感，你這樣的人會非常喜歡……"/pause 400/faceDirection MrQi 1 true/pause 50/faceDirection MrQi 0/pause 500/speak MrQi "現在，恕我失陪……還有重要的事得處理。"/pause 2000/end

spring_day_ambient/100 23/farmer 94 23 1 Haley 100 23 1/skippable/pause 2000/showFrame Haley 25/pause 500/playSound cameraNoise/shake Haley 50/screenFlash .5/pause 800/pause 500/faceDirection Haley 2 true/showFrame Haley 24/pause 500/playSound cameraNoise/shake Haley 50/screenFlash .5/move farmer 5 0 1 true/pause 1200/faceDirection Haley 3 true/showFrame Haley 27/pause 400/jump Haley/pause 600/showFrame Haley 12/faceDirection Haley 3/pause 300/speak Haley "哦！@。$8"/pause 500/faceDirection Haley 2/pause 800/speak Haley "現在的光線太美了……我非得出來拍些大自然的照片。"/pause 600/faceDirection Haley 3/pause 600/faceDirection Haley 3/pause 400/speak Haley "我一直在試著多接觸戶外……#$b#想知道當農民是什麼感覺。這種生活方式我以前從沒認真想過。#$b#嗯，直到現在……$l"/pause 500/faceDirection Haley 0/pause 800/speak Haley "嘿，這些牛真可愛……"/pause 600/emote Haley 16/faceDirection Haley 3/speak Haley "嘿，我有個主意！$h"/move Haley 0 1 2/faceDirection farmer 2/playSound sandyStep/addBigProp 100 25 106/pause 600/move Haley 0 -1 3/faceDirection farmer 1/speak Haley "我們和這些牛一起拍幾張照片吧！你可以教我怎麼靠近牠。$h#$b#我只要把相機設成定時拍攝就行。"/move Haley 0 1 2/faceDirection farmer 2/pause 900/playSound openBox/move Haley 0 -1 3/faceDirection farmer 1/pause 700/faceDirection farmer 0/faceDirection Haley 0/playMusic 50s/globalFade/viewport -1000 -1000/cutscene haleyCows/pause 2000/speak Haley "……呃……$9"/pause 1000/speak Haley "*咯咯笑*$10#$b#真好玩，@！……而且這些照片太搞笑了！$10"/pause 500/speak Haley "我現在要回家洗澡了……$10"/pause 1000/mail haleyGarden/end dialogue Haley "嗯，這是我這輩子最髒的一次。$h"

nightTime/-1000 -1000/farmer 18 8 1 Linus 29 8 2/skippable/specificTemporarySprite linusCampfire/viewport 29 7 clamp true/move farmer 8 0 1/faceDirection Linus 3/emote Linus 32/speak Linus "@！過來站在火堆旁邊。感覺很舒服。"/pause 400/move farmer 2 0 2/move farmer 0 1 1/move Linus 1 0 2/move Linus 0 1 3/pause 1500/speak Linus "我一直希望你有空會過來。"/pause 500/emote Linus 28/pause 500/faceDirection Linus 2/pause 500/showFrame Linus 19/pause 500/speak Linus "我想為最初不信任你而道歉。$s#$b#大多數人對我都不好，所以我學會了小心提防。$s"/pause 500/showFrame Linus 0/faceDirection Linus 3/speak Linus "但你對我格外友善。你是個與眾不同的人。$h#$b#……而且我把你視為好朋友。"/pause 500/faceDirection Linus 3/emote farmer 32/pause 1000/faceDirection Linus 3/move Linus 0 -1 3/move Linus -1 0 0/speak Linus "嘿，我想給你看樣東西。進來吧。$h"/move farmer 0 -1 1/move Linus 0 -1 0/playSound grassyStep/warp Linus -10 -10/move farmer 1 0 0/move farmer 0 -1 0/playSound grassyStep/warp farmer -10 -10/playMusic none/pause 1500/playSound fishSlap/pause 500/playSound fishSlap/pause 500/playSound fishSlap/pause 500/playSound fishSlap/pause 800/playSound dirtyHit/pause 1200/playSound slimeHit/pause 300/playSound slimeHit/pause 300/playSound slimeHit/pause 300/playSound slimeHit/pause 600/playSound slimedead/pause 1000/speak Linus "啊……好了。看到這個了嗎？這是我製作的特殊魚餌。#$b#全都是最高品質……連我自己都想吃！#$b#來，我想把配方送給你。"/pause 500/playSound coin/pause 500/faceDirection farmer 2/warp farmer 29 7/playSound grassyStep/move farmer 0 1 2/pause 1000/showFrame 84/playSound reward/addCraftingRecipe Wild Bait/message "學會製作「萬用魚餌」"/pause 900/end
